macro.text: Brazilian stocks are rocked after Lula wins the presidential runoff; Bolsonaro reportedly refuses to concede.
Anthropic files its prospectus, starting the countdown to a blockbuster IPO.
Oil falls as the Saudi defense minister travels to Iran for talks aimed at de-escalating the conflict.

read: The open held and broadened the morning's mild risk-on tone: SPY, roughly flat premarket at 763.13, is now 765.15 (+0.68% on the day, +0.38% since the 9:30 open near 762.2), and QQQ is 709.49 (+0.72%, +0.34% since the open near 707.1), only a touch above its 709.22 premarket print, so tech's early lead has been joined rather than extended. The VIX is down about 4% to 18.63, the 10-year yield has eased to 4.97% from about 4.99% premarket, and WTI is down about 1.8% at $101.43 but roughly flat since the open after news of Saudi-Iran de-escalation talks. There are no high-impact scheduled releases left today, so the remaining drivers are headlines: Iran, how Meta's $95 billion offering and the AI infrastructure names trade, and the Anthropic IPO filing.
